source: Clearance: ISO 273:1979 fine / medium / coarse series (close / normal / loose). Tap drill: ISO 2306 / DIN 336 coarse-thread tap drill sizes. Counterbore for ISO 4762 socket heads: common counterbore table (JIS B 1176 / Misumi style, e.g. M3 6.5 x 3.3). Pilot hole for thread-forming screws in plastics: approx. 0.8 d (ABS guideline; PC ~0.85 d, PA ~0.75 d).

derived.note: Heads without a tabulated counterbore/countersink (button, pan, flat) get dk + counterbore_dia_add x k + counterbore_depth_add, or a countersink of dk(theoretical) + countersink_dia_add at the head angle. These are flagged derived=true.
